name: Heli-Strike: Alien Siege
summary: Prepare for a pulse-pounding VR experience where the fate of humanity rests in your hands. Giant alien spiders and flying insectoids have invaded Earth, threatening to overrun major cities. As an elite member of the Military Gunship Corps, you’ll take the fight to the skies and the ground. With cutting-edge VR immersion, you'll alternate between gripping roles: piloting a heavily armed gunship helicopter, operating as a sharpshooting gunner, or leading daring ground rescue missions to save civilians trapped
